headline_marked: Rooppur Unit 1 [[begins test to generate power]]
headline: Rooppur Unit 1 begins test to generate power
summary: Bangladesh enters the nuclear power era as the first unit of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant starts generating electricity for internal testing.
details: Unit 1 of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant has entered a key operational phase, beginning the process of generating electricity after receiving regulatory approval.
The process involves a gradual increase in the reactor's pressure and temperature to drive the turbine and produce steam, marking the start of a series of critical tests.
According to Dr Md Zahedul Hasan, managing director of NPCBL, the current 'Stage C' phase monitors the performance of major plant systems under operating conditions.
These tests include coordinating the reactor, primary and secondary systems, turbine-generators, and safety mechanisms to ensure everything functions properly before commercial use.
Officials clarified that electricity is not yet being supplied to the national grid, as Unit 1 must complete all Stage C tests before synchronisation.
The Bangladesh Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority approved the transition to this phase on Thursday, with hopes that the unit will supply the national grid by the end of this year.
Located in Ishwardi, Pabna, the $12.65 billion facility was built with Russian technical and financial assistance and features two VVER-1200 reactors.
Once both units are fully operational, the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant is expected to add 2,400 megawatts of electricity to the national grid.
caption:
Bangladesh enters the nuclear power era! Rooppur Unit 1 has officially begun generating electricity for testing.

Unit 1 of the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant has entered a key operational phase, beginning the process of generating electricity after receiving regulatory approval.

The process involves a gradual increase in the reactor's pressure and temperature to drive the turbine and produce steam, marking the start of a series of critical tests.

According to Dr Md Zahedul Hasan, managing director of NPCBL, the current 'Stage C' phase monitors the performance of major plant systems under operating conditions.

These tests include coordinating the reactor, primary and secondary systems, turbine-generators, and safety mechanisms to ensure everything functions properly before commercial use.

Officials clarified that electricity is not yet being supplied to the national grid, as Unit 1 must complete all Stage C tests before synchronisation.

The Bangladesh Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority approved the transition to this phase on Thursday, with hopes that the unit will supply the national grid by the end of this year.

Located in Ishwardi, Pabna, the $12.65 billion facility was built with Russian technical and financial assistance and features two VVER-1200 reactors.

Once both units are fully operational, the Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant is expected to add 2,400 megawatts of electricity to the national grid.

topic: al activists arrested after cocktail blasts
headline_marked: 13 cocktails recovered as [[4 AL and affiliate activists arrested]] in Dhaka
headline: 13 cocktails recovered as 4 AL and affiliate activists arrested in Dhaka
summary: Police arrested four members of the banned Awami League and Jubo League after a cocktail blast in the Kalabagan area of the capital.
details: Police arrested four members of the banned Awami League and Jubo League on Friday afternoon following a cocktail blast in the capital's Kalabagan area.
According to the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), 10 to 15 activists arrived on 7 to 8 motorcycles around 12:15 PM to display banners and create panic by detonating cocktails.
The Dhanmondi Model Police Station OC, who arrived at the scene, was targeted by the cocktails but managed to save himself and detained two suspects, Nazmul and Billal.
The other two suspects, Shamimur Rahman, president of the Tejgaon Industrial Area AL, and Kamrunnahar Lipi, were arrested by Kalabagan police near the pedestrian bridge.
Police recovered three unexploded cocktails from the scene and later found 10 more based on information from the arrested individuals, totaling 13 cocktails.
The DMP's Bomb Disposal Unit has since deactivated all 13 recovered cocktails.
In a separate incident, police arrested Jahidul Islam and Shihab Hossain in Moghbazar's Nayatola area on Friday morning, recovering four cocktails from them.
The Moghbazar arrests were linked to a cocktail blast near the Ramna Shopping Complex on Friday night, for which a case was filed at the Ramna Model Police Station.
